### 1. Request, timing, action boundary, authorisation
The caller (Ines Whitcombe, Whitcombe Web Works LLC) wants to "put enough on my account credit so they come out of credit, not my card" for "my Pro plan for the Wavecrest Dental site and the things that run on it". Object: the account credit of her account; the amount is to be worked out by the agent. She pays by card and wants to make the payment herself. The simulator only conveys need, answers identity questions one or two at a time, agrees when told that "some credits have to be put on your account before the amount can be worked out", and runs the user tool when handed it. Identity: `verify_customer_identity` with email + phone -> "Identity verified ... (2 detail(s) matched)".

### 2. Act / wait / refuse at the frozen moment
Act now. Visible grounds: account record `status='active'`, `variant_name='Harborline Reseller Bronze'`, `credit_balance=25.27`; hub "Prefund Deposits for Hosting Renewals": "A deposit may be accepted only while the account status is active"; deposit terms table: Bronze minimum $100.00, maximum $10000.00, balance cap $25000.00, methods "card, PayPal, bank transfer". Scope of the prefund computation ("Calculating the Hosting Renewal Prefund", "Who and what the prefund covers"): exactly one initial-term charge on hosting billing (HL-05105259); plan `89585be8…` Harborline Pro `active`, `auto_renew=True`, term end 2026-11-01 -> attempt days (first day per hosting charter, then 3 and 1 days before: 2026-10-29, 2026-10-31) — next attempt is within 14 days whatever the first-attempt figure (the hosting top-up doc gives 7 -> 2026-10-25); scheduled change is a `term_change` to 24 months (not a downgrade); most recent tier review `2025-09-12 … review_result='qualified'`; one active security plan on the plan (SiteGuard Plus), one active certificate with auto-renew (OV Single Domain, `hosting_id` = the plan), one email on the primary domain wavecrestdental.net (Harborline Mail Pro, `annual_prepaid`, no scheduled product). In scope.

### 3. Narrowest object, keys, include/exclude
Account `3488f8f5-c2f9-4cbe-a9bc-7b7815d009d0`. Counted holdings: the plan, the security plan whose `hosting_id` is the plan, the certificate whose `hosting_id` is the plan, the email on `email_domain=wavecrestdental.net` (= plan `primary_domain`), the free domain `wavecrestsmiles.com` (`bundled_hosting_id` = the plan). Excluded: the five other domains (not the plan's free domain; "Charges of any other holding are not counted by the prefund"); the withdrawn 36-month term change (status `withdrawn`).

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Three goodwill grants (agent tools), then (b) the prefund deposit (user tool).** Bronze goodwill limits: per case $50.00, yearly $100.00; no goodwill entry on the ledger, so yearly room $100.00 throughout (sum of the three below is under $100 in any order).

**G-A Late-provisioning goodwill** ("Amount of Late-Provisioning Goodwill"): plan of the most recent initial-term charge (2025-11-01, unique), active, `first_term=True`, ordered (`opened_date`/charge date) 2025-11-01, `activated_date` 2025-11-10 -> 9 days (>= 2). Baseline: daily term value 107.88 / 365 (term 2025-11-01 -> 2026-11-01) x 9 = 2.660055 -> fall-back 2.66.
Factors found and tiers:
- compensation basis ("Compensation Basis by Length of Delay"): 9 days -> "7 or more" -> monthly term value 107.88/12 = 8.99 per started week, 2 weeks = 17.98 (found from the plan's order/activation dates);
- plan class multiplier: `variant_name='Harborline Pro'` -> 1.25;
- commitment multiplier by hosting term: `billing_term_months=12` -> 1.05;
- prior-remedy multiplier: plan's own lines show `charge_type='sla_credit'` (uptime month 2026-08), no refund line -> 0.8;
- site-outage uplift: primary domain wavecrestdental.net `status='active'`, `nameservers='harborline_dns'` -> $10.00;
- money-back period uplift: needs the Pro tier's money-back days on Web Hosting Plans (**conditional**, hosting unpublished): $3.00 if 9 >= 0.25 x money-back days, else nothing.
Assembly (multipliers, then uplifts, then limits, round once): 17.98 x 1.25 x 1.05 x 0.8 = 18.879; + 10.00 (+ 3.00 conditional) = **31.88** (or 28.88 if the money-back uplift does not apply). Posted against `HL-05105259`.

**G-B Late-review goodwill** ("Late-Review Goodwill Computation"): most recent approved request `ef497a61-5d5a-424d-ba39-2e0ccf4557f9`, submitted 2026-09-28, decided 2026-10-07 -> 9 days (> 7), 2 days late. Baseline $2.00 x 2 = 4.00 (fall-back).
Factors: compensation basis (late review): 2 late days -> "2 or more but fewer than 7" -> $8.00 flat; lock-out severity multiplier: `requested_change='change_login_email'` -> 1.25; evidence-burden uplift: `recovery_method='government_id'` -> $5.00; failed sign-in uplift: lockouts that began after 2026-08-22: 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-04 (2026-07-30, 2026-08-02 excluded) -> 2 -> $3.00; live-service uplift: active hosting plan held -> $4.00.
8.00 x 1.25 + 5 + 3 + 4 = **22.00**. Posted against `ef497a61-5d5a-424d-ba39-2e0ccf4557f9`.

**G-C Duplicate-charge goodwill** ("Same-Day Duplicate Charge Goodwill: Computation"): latest domain auto-renew refund line 2026-08-24 (only one on that date) refunds charge `3e8599d0…` (HL-05106629, $17.64, card, 2026-08-13); whitcombewebworks.com shows two auto-renew lines dated 2026-08-13. 11 days to refund. Baseline 25% x 17.64 = 4.41 (fall-back).
Factors: compensation basis (time to refund): 11 days -> "7 days or more" -> 17.64 + $3.00 x 2 started weeks = 23.64; size uplift: 17.64 in $15.00–$49.99 -> $2.00; funding-route uplift: paid by card, refund line `refund_destination='account_credit'`, ledger refund entry with `source_charge_ref='HL-05106629'` present -> $3.00; reseller partner uplift: Bronze, `tier_changed_date` 2026-01-19 on/before 2026-08-13 -> $2.00.
23.64 + 2 + 3 + 2 = **30.64**. Posted against `HL-05106629`.

**Prefund deposit** — balance counted after the three grants: 25.27 (= sum of ledger entries, checked) + 31.88 + 22.00 + 30.64 = 109.79 (106.79 if the money-back uplift does not apply).
Counted charges (baseline counts only the plan at its 12-month rate; factor documents add the rest):
- plan renewal: scheduled term change to 24 months -> "Renewal Term Rates Used in a Hosting Prefund": Pro regular 24-month monthly rate x 24, less Bronze hosting 10% (**conditional**: hosting rate);
- email: Harborline Mail Pro, next attempt 2026-10-29 (7/3/1 before 2026-11-05 per email renewal schedule) -> within 14 days; `scheduled_seat_count=2` -> 2 x 5.99 x 12 = 143.76, less Bronze email 5% -> 136.57;
- security: SiteGuard Plus 12-month, renewal 7 days before 2026-11-03 = 2026-10-27 -> counted; 59.88 less the higher of hosted-site 15% and Bronze 10% -> 50.90;
- certificate: OV Single Domain, end 2026-11-22, 2-year last term, 0 extra names; counted only if the SSL charter's auto-renew day before the end falls on/before 2026-11-05 (**conditional**); 2-year price per year x 2, less Bronze SSL 10%;
- free domain wavecrestsmiles.com (.com), expiry 2026-11-28, attempts: domain-charter first day, then 14/7/1 before; the 14-day retry (2026-11-14) is outside the window, so it is counted only if the first attempt day is >= 15 days before expiry (**conditional**); .com renewal x auto-renew years less Bronze 3%, plus ICANN fee.
Prefund = sum of counted charges − 109.79; at least $100.00; refused if > $10000.00 or balance would exceed $25000.00. Final figure **conditional** on the hosting/ssl/domain figures; the visible part fixes every other term.
**Fall-back** (computation doc only, no factor, baseline goodwill figures 2.66 + 4.00 + 4.41): Pro 12-month rate x 12 less 10% − 36.34, floored at $100.00 — definite once the hosting rate is published, and different from the answer above (adds email 136.57 + security 50.90 at least, and a lower balance).

### 5. Tool sequence
find_customers -> verify_customer_identity -> find_account_holdings / ledger / events / recovery requests / hosting / domain / ssl / email / security records -> unlock + call `grant_provisioning_goodwill_e1bd747b`, `grant_recovery_delay_goodwill_1cc515a4`, `grant_duplicate_charge_goodwill_d451e88f` (owner agent, any order) -> compute the prefund -> `unlock_user_discoverable_tool make_prefund_deposit_8453f2b2`, give account id, `funding_method=card`, amount -> customer runs it -> terminal: one deposit entry, card.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone
Root: prefund deposit (customer's own write; hub: "The agent unlocks the customer-side tool … and the customer themselves runs it").
- Hop 1 (state-derived): hub sentence "The prefund deposit is fixed only after the credit ledger carries a goodwill entry for the hosting plan of the customer's most recent initial-term charge whenever that plan, active and in its first term, was activated two or more calendar days after its order date …". Records: activated 9 days after order, no goodwill entry. Search "goodwill" + "provisioning"/"activated late" -> "Goodwill Schedule for Late Hosting Provisioning" describes the write ("credits goodwill to the account, without the customer having to ask, for the hosting plan of the customer's most recent initial-term charge when that plan … was activated late").
- Hop 2 (state-derived): "The prefund deposit is not fixed until the credit ledger carries a goodwill entry for the account's most recent approved recovery request whenever that request was decided more than seven calendar days after it was submitted …". Records: 9 days. "Trust and Safety: Goodwill for Late Recovery Review Decisions" describes the write.
- Hop 3 (state-derived): "Before the prefund deposit is worked out, the credit ledger must carry a goodwill entry for the most recently refunded domain auto-renew charge whenever no other domain auto-renew refund line shares its refund date, the refunded charge had a same-day twin auto-renew charge of the same domain …". Records: single refund line 2026-08-24, twin lines 2026-08-13. "Goodwill Schedule for Same-Day Duplicate Domain Auto-Renew Charges" describes the write.
- No hop among the three goodwill problems; their documents carry no prerequisite sentence. Order: three grants (any order) -> prefund computed on the raised balance -> user deposit. No hop pre-solved: the hub names only its own tool; the goodwill documents name only their own.

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only the deposit": the hub's three sentences make the amount "fixed only after" / "not fixed until" / "Before … worked out" the ledger carries the entries; computing on 25.27 leaves the governed amount fixed before its waited-on state holds — excluded by visible text.
- Agent-run deposit vs user-run: hub "the customer themselves runs it" and the persona's own-payment wish; excluded.
- 12-month rate vs 24-month: scheduled term change record + term-rate document; the withdrawn 36-month request excluded by `request_status='withdrawn'`.
- Email seats 3 vs 2: "its scheduled seat count where one is set" -> 2.
- Other domains' renewals: excluded by "Charges of any other holding are not counted by the prefund".
- Late-reset goodwill (not a prerequisite here): notice 2026-10-11 14:30 equals approval + 96 h; not more than 1 day after -> would be outside that schedule anyway; the hub does not wait on it.
- Factor findability: every factor above was reached from record words (sla_credit line on hosting billing; `nameservers`; `recovery_method`; `requested_change`; lockout events; `refund_destination` + ledger refund entry; `tier_changed_date`; scheduled term change; email `scheduled_seat_count`; security plan `hosting_id`; certificate `hosting_id`; domain `bundled_hosting_id`).
- Baseline-hint observation (carried to dependency_form): the prefund computation document says "The prefund covers the charges that keep the website on the hosting plan running …" and "together with every other counted charge, all added together, less every discount that applies"; the three goodwill computation documents say "the figure is first multiplied by every multiplier that applies, the fixed uplifts that apply are then added" / "the fixed uplifts that apply are added". These told the reader that variations exist before any record was read.

contamination_disclosure: none. The brief carried no scored value.

### Cross-product consistency of the charges the prefund counts
- Plan, security plan and free domain: the account documents' counted charge equals what the owning published rule bills for that auto-renewal. Plan 24-month regular rate less 10%; security annual price less the higher of 15% and 10%; free domain renewal less 3% + ICANN.
- **Email (S3):**
  - The account email-charge document counts "its scheduled seat count where one is set" (2 seats).
  - The published Professional Email term-renewal rule ("Professional Email Term Renewals of Active Subscriptions": a term renewal is the renewal of an active subscription that falls due on its term end date, billed on or before its due date) bills renewed seats as "the lower of the scheduled seat count and the seat count on the subscription, but never fewer than the mailboxes in use, the seat count less the idle seats" ("Professional Email Term Renewal: Seats of Deleted Mailboxes").
  - This subscription has 3 seats and no mailbox deletion (find_email_events: none), so 3 mailboxes are in use and the email product bills 3 seats. The prefund counts 2.
- **Certificate (S4):**
  - The account certificate document counts the 2-year price x 2 less the 10% tier SSL discount.
  - The published SSL auto-renew charge rule adds factors to the list amount: "Reseller Discount on Certificate Auto-Renewals", "Organisation Re-Vetting Fee on OV and EV Auto-Renewals" (OV validation age at end + 365 = 738 > 398 days -> 29.00), "Harborline Domain Credit on Certificate Auto-Renewals" (covered domain active on Harborline DNS -> 6.00).
